# CG-SCHEMA-903: Unresolved reference in compared schema

A compared schema contains a reference that could not be resolved.

**Why it matters:** Only reachable with allowInvalidSpec.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Schemas](./#schema) |
| Detects | `schema.unresolvedReference` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: high |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Reference {raw} in {where} could not be resolved.
>
> The referenced schema is unknown, so the comparison is incomplete.
>
> **Fix:** Fix the reference.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: unresolved reference

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {$ref: './missing.yaml#/X'}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Undetermined, high. Reference ./missing.yaml#/X in POST /x: the request body (application/json) could not be resolved.

### Does not fire: all references resolve

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/A'}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
- components:
-   schemas:
-     A: {type: string}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
